nfl.own_rating_game_state_prior.assessment: Same quantity as nfl.model_team_points_mean (market-free team expected points and margin with SD). The MARKET_MARKER flag is a false positive: the text only states that no spread/total is used. The hard-coded margin SD 13.0 and total SD 9.5 should come from nfl.heteroskedastic_margin_sd instead.

nfl.own_team_rating_market_free.assessment: Canonical market-free points rating; mostly exact, but the ridge penalty is unspecified, the returning-production term is ambiguous, and the QB term cites a catalog input whose conversion is itself shaky. Leak risk: final-season ratings and returning production must be frozen at the prior season end / preseason roster date, and the 2002-2025 recalibration must be walk-forward.

nfl.own_team_rating_market_free.measurement_fix: Weekly rating in points of margin per game: ridge regression (penalty lambda chosen by leave-one-season-out CV, start at 20 game-equivalents) of capped game margin (cap +/-24) on team and opponent indicators plus a home indicator (home constant refit yearly, about 1.5), over all games since the start of the prior season, weights exp(-ln2*games_ago/10); average 50/50 with an opponent-adjusted EPA/play margin rating converted to points (EPA margin x about 63 plays per team-game, refit yearly). Preseason prior = 0.67 x last-season final rating + 0.10 x (returning-production pct minus league mean pct)/10 points, where returning production = share of prior-season snaps (offence and defence) held by players on the roster at the week-1 cutoff, + QB-change term = (EPA/dropback prior of new starter minus old starter) x 38 dropbacks. Prior sd 4.0 points; posterior sd = 1/sqrt(1/4.0^2 + n/13.5^2). As-of next kickoff; spread, total and moneyline excluded.

nfl.paired_score_covariance_own.assessment: Useful for both-teams-score-35 style legs but under-specified: the wind bins leave a 10-15 mph gap, the order of copula sampling versus home/venue shifts is ambiguous, and it overlaps nfl.leg_dependence_by_model_regime. Bin correlations on ~4,000 games with k=150 shrinkage are noisy; discrete scores need a Gaussian-copula-on-PMF mapping stated explicitly.

sources.name: nflverse schedules/games.csv

nfl.paired_score_covariance_own.measurement_fix: Using 2010-2025 regular-season games, compute residual correlation rho_b of (home score - own model home mean) and (away score - own model away mean), where means are walk-forward outputs of nfl.model_team_points_mean including the home shift and dome flag. Bins: expected total (<40, 40-50, >50 model points) x wind (<10, 10-15, >=15 mph; roofed games count as calm), 9 cells; shrink each rho_b toward the pooled rho with weight n_b/(n_b+150). Simulate pairs by drawing a bivariate normal with rho_b, mapping each margin through the inverse CDF of that team's nfl.team_score_pmf_own_mean marginal (Gaussian copula on integer scores). Output P(both scores >= 35) and rho_b per cell. As-of kickoff weather forecast and model means; no betting total used.

nfl.pass_run_split_epa_both_sides.assessment: Genuine decomposition (pass/run, offence/defence) not present in nfl.off_epa/def_epa, but the pass share is sourced from 'nfl.pace-adjusted neutral pass rate', which is not a defined quantity (pace does not give pass share; nfl.proe does). Window wording (2016+ for league means vs last 12 games) mixes two scales. Win-probability garbage filter must use a no-spread WP.
raw_data: pbp: game_id, posteam, defteam, play_type, epa, wp, qb_kneel, qb_spike, qb_dropback
nfl.pass_run_split_epa_both_sides.measurement_fix: Per team, from 2016+ regular-season plays excluding kneels, spikes and plays with pre-play wp below 0.05 or above 0.95 (no-spread nflfastR wp): off EPA per dropback, off EPA per rush, def EPA per dropback faced, def EPA per rush faced, each opponent-adjusted by ridge over the last 12 games with exp half-life 6 games, shrunk to league mean with weight n/(n+150) for pass and n/(n+100) for rush (n = plays). Expected EPA/play for team A vs B = pA x (offA_pass - defB_pass) + (1-pA) x (offA_rush - defB_rush) where pA = A's neutral-situation pass rate = league expected pass rate (nfl.proe model) + A's PROE, as of last completed game. Output four components plus the blended rate.

nfl.per_game_rate_persistence.assessment: Reasonable variance-component idea but the stat list and count distribution are undefined, 'season total variance' formula ignores games remaining uncertainty and between-opportunity correlation, and per-position-stat fits are not specified. Point-in-time: u must be estimated only from games before the as-of week.
raw_data: player-game stats: player_id, season, week, position, targets, receptions, rec_yards, carries, rush_yards, pass_att, pass_yards, TDs
nfl.per_game_rate_persistence.measurement_fix: For each position x stat in {targets, receptions, receiving yards, carries, rushing yards, pass attempts, passing yards, TDs} fit on 2012-2025 player-games (player played at least 1 snap) a Poisson/negative-binomial GLMM y_ij ~ NB(mu_ij, phi) with log mu_ij = a_pos + u_i,season + log(exposure_ij), u ~ N(0, sigma_u^2); report sigma_u, phi and ICC = sigma_u^2/(sigma_u^2+mean within variance). Season-to-date posterior of u_i uses only games before the as-of week with shrinkage weight n_games/(n_games + phi/ sigma_u^2 scale); remaining-games total variance = m x Var(e) + m^2 x Var(u|data) where m is remaining games from nfl.games_played_dist.

nfl.period_drive_scoring_rates.assessment: Specific enough (multinomial logit, half-life, k, garbage-time exclusion) and market-free. Overlaps nfl.drive_outcome_by_index and nfl.drive_result_lattice but adds the period dimension. Subtle: drive_result must use final drive results, and random-effect refits must be walk-forward.
raw_data: pbp: game_id, drive, qtr, drive_result (fixed_drive_result), posteam, defteam, wp

nfl.period_zero_tie_mass.assessment: Bivariate smoothing model and calibration are named but not specified, and 'as-of start of season with rolling refresh' conflicts with the quarter-level marginals that depend on game-specific drive allocation. Atom masses at 0/3/7 need a stated construction.

nfl.period_zero_tie_mass.measurement_fix: From 2010-2025 regular-season quarters (regulation only) tabulate P(home pts=a, away pts=b) per quarter q in 1..4. Model: independent per-team quarter-points PMFs from nfl.period_drive_scoring_rates x nfl.drive_clock_allocation (drives per quarter), then add a Gaussian-copula correlation per quarter estimated from the data (shrink to pooled with k=300 games). Fix atoms at 0,3,6,7,10 by isotonic regression of simulated against empirical frequency within expected-total terciles (low <42, mid 42-48, high >48 model total). Report P(0-0), P(tie) and P(both score) per quarter; as-of kickoff using the pregame model inputs, refit once per season, never using the game's own quarters.

nfl.play_length_evt_tail_fit.assessment: Well specified peaks-over-threshold fit with era term and uncertainty propagation. Subtle: 99-yard plays are about 2-3 per decade so the tail is extrapolated from the 60-yard threshold; kick-distance rule eras and kickoff touchback rules change exposure; return-length fields must be kept separate from scrimmage gains as the definition says.

nfl.player_destination_choice.assessment: Two-stage structure is sensible but several features are undefined or unmeasurable at the as-of time (reported-interest flag, starter quality gap, scheme ties) and only ~100-150 meaningful veteran moves per year make a 31-way multinomial fragile. Cap data from OTC is revised after the fact, so vintage snapshots are needed.
raw_data: team cap space by date (vintage snapshots)
depth charts / starter value by position
nfl.player_destination_choice.measurement_fix: Stage 1: P(move) = logistic on 2012-2025 veteran offseasons (contract expired or released) with features years remaining, franchise-tag eligibility flag, age, prior-season snap share, retirement-eligible age; ridge lambda by CV. Stage 2: conditional multinomial logit over 31 other teams with features (i) team cap space on the as-of date from a dated OTC snapshot, (ii) starter gap = team's best current starter's EPA-or-grade percentile at the player's position minus the player's, floored at 0, (iii) draft capital spent at the position in the last 2 drafts, (iv) 1[head coach or coordinator previously coached player], (v) 1[prior-team-of-record tie]; drop the subjective 'reported interest' flag unless captured with timestamp (own_capture). P(retire/no team) from age-position base rate. Shrink utilities with Dirichlet alpha=1. As-of timestamped snapshot before the decision window.

nfl.player_longest_reception_max_model.assessment: Same max-of-K-catches exceedance formula as nfl.player_reception_length_distribution (1 - F(x)^N); only the source of N and the length model differ. Keep one definition: the other input has the cleaner distribution fit. The 'no live snap' multiplier belongs in nfl.zero_snap_active_risk.

nfl.player_reception_length_distribution.assessment: Keeper of the max-reception family. The opponent factor is specified (k=120) but not how it enters the distribution, and N is left to 'projected receptions distribution'. Leak risk: none if windows are strictly prior games; catch-only samples ignore that long targets that fall incomplete are not in the max.
raw_data: pbp: receiver_id, complete_pass, yards_gained, air_yards, yards_after_catch, defteam, game_id
nfl.player_reception_length_distribution.measurement_fix: For each receiver take completions from the last 24 games before the as-of date (need at least 40, else pool to the position-alignment template with weight 30 receptions), length = yards_gained. Fit a log-normal body below the 85th percentile of the pooled sample and a generalized Pareto tail above it. Opponent factor f = (defence's allowed rate of receptions >=20 yards per reception over last 16 games, shrunk to league with k=120 receptions) / league rate, multiplied into the tail exceedance probability (capped 0.6-1.7). N = projected receptions from nfl.targets x nfl.catch_rate_oe as a negative binomial. P(longest >= x) = 1 - sum_n P(N=n) (1-S(x))^n where S is the survival function including f; output at each strike; multiply by P(active and snaps).

nfl.player_single_game_yardage_extreme_r.assessment: Market-free by construction (explicitly no spread) but the 'starter-pull cap at margins above 28' is undefined, carries mean depends on nfl.carries which in the catalog is only loosely defined, and 200+ yard games (about 5-10 per season) give a tiny calibration sample. Duplicates part of nfl.game_rushing_leader_field_sim.
raw_data: team rush attempts, own-model expected margin
nfl.player_single_game_yardage_extreme_r.measurement_fix: For each rusher-game: carries ~ NB with mean = player carry share (last 8 games, half-life 4, shrink to depth-slot prior with k=3 games) x team rush attempts, where team attempts are a function of own-model expected margin (nfl.own_team_rating_market_free, no betting spread) fitted on 2015-2025 team-games; per-carry yards drawn from the discrete tail of nfl.rush_yardage_tail with the opponent explosive-allowed adjustment; in simulated paths where the team leads by 28+ in Q4 cap the rusher's remaining carries at 2. Report P(yards >= 200/225/250). Calibrate by comparing simulated count of 200+ games per season with the 2000-2025 empirical frequency per season (scale intercept only). As-of start of week.

nfl.player_trade_hazard.assessment: Discrete-time hazard with named covariates and base-rate shrinkage; plausible and market-free. Weak points: 'positional value tier' is undefined, trades cluster at the deadline and draft (not smooth hazard), and OTC contract fields are revised, so covariates must use dated snapshots. About 20-40 player trades per year means small samples.
raw_data: transactions: date, player_id, from_team, to_team, type
contracts: cap hit, dead cap by year, years remaining

nfl.player_xtd.assessment: Same quantity as nfl.expected_touchdowns_by_play_location (play-level P(TD | yardline, down, distance, type) summed per player, shrunk to role). This version adds a team-share step and slightly different window; consolidate. ff_opportunity field names are unverified.

nfl.position_peer_production_index.assessment: Weights are explicit assumptions, 'pressures per game (if available)' is not in public weekly data (needs participation/PFF/NGS), and the QB composite refers to another input rather than a computed z-score. Award voting differs by award, so weights fit to DPOY vote share only generalize poorly (about 20 data points).
raw_data: weekly player stats: player_id, week, position, sacks, qb_hits, def_interceptions, passes_defended, tackles_for_loss, forced_fumbles
nfl.position_peer_production_index.measurement_fix: Offensive: per-game EPA contributed (QB: EPA per dropback x dropbacks per game + 0.5 x CPOE-based EPA; RB/WR/TE: rushing or receiving EPA per game from pbp) converted to a z-score vs all same-position players over 2015-2025 at the same week of season; Defenders: z = 0.40 sacks/g + 0.20 QB hits/g + 0.15 TFL/g + 0.15 (interceptions + passes defended)/g + 0.10 forced fumbles/g using only public weekly fields (no pressures), weights fit by conditional logit on past DPOY voting, ridge toward the stated values. Shrink z toward 0 with weight g/(g+5) (g=games). Rank within eligible pool (rookie flag for rookie awards); output rank and z-gap to next. As-of last completed week.

nfl.preseason_long_kick_evidence.assessment: Preseason and warm-up 55+ yard attempts are a handful per year, nflverse pbp does not reliably include preseason games, and warm-up makes rely on beat reports with no standard capture. 'Half weight per attempt' is ad hoc. Marginal over nfl.kicker and nfl.kicker_ceiling_range_tail.

nfl.primetime_flex_probability.assessment: Counting rule is partly defined but the flex model is not (no features beyond record and prior primetime count, no training data stated), and flex rules differ by network and week (flexible scheduling windows differ for SNF, MNF and Thursday). Only about 5-10 flex moves per season make estimation thin.

nfl.primetime_flex_probability.measurement_fix: Base count B_t = number of games for team t designated in the released schedule in national windows (Thursday night, Sunday night, Monday night, Thanksgiving, Christmas, excluding the Wednesday opener and Saturday-doubleheader windows unless the contract says otherwise). For each remaining week w in the flex-eligible windows per current league rules (verify each season against the league's published flex policy), compute P(team t flexed in) and P(flexed out) by logistic regression on 2023-2025 flexible-slot decisions with features team win%, opponent win%, playoff-leverage flag, team's primetime count so far (cap of 7 games) and the league's 12-day notice deadline. Expected final count = B_t + sum_w (P_in - P_out); output the full PMF by Poisson-binomial convolution. As-of latest flex announcement.

nfl.pro_bowl_flag_roster_strength.assessment: Pro Bowl is a flag-football exhibition with roster replacements, opt-outs and about 3 games of format history; the logit coefficient is shrunk almost to zero so the output is effectively 50/50 plus noise. Retains value only as a documented prior.

regular-season QB CPOE and EPA per dropback, WR/TE yards per route run
Pro Bowl Games results by year

nfl.prospect_declaration_eligibility_med.assessment: Vague: no model form beyond a feature list, 'medical flag risk' is undefined and combine updates are not parameterised. Public injury histories are sparse and as-of timing of early-entry lists is the main source of knowledge (declaration deadline is a hard date).
nfl.prospect_declaration_eligibility_med.measurement_fix: P(declare) per underclass prospect by logistic regression on early-entry outcomes of 2021-2026 classes (NIL era, fitted separately from 2010-2020) with features class year, position, consensus round bucket (1, 2-3, 4-7, undrafted) from nfl.prospect_slot_dispersion_model, consensus-rank percentile, and an injury flag = 1 if the player missed 4+ games in either of the last two seasons from team injury reports or beat reports; ridge lambda by CV. Add post-combine/pro-day update: replace round bucket by the updated consensus rank. P(in pool) = P(declare) for eligible players, 1 for exhausted-eligibility seniors. As-of the last official list or the player's dated statement; no market data.

nfl.prospect_eligibility_clock_and_nil_e.assessment: Eligibility-clock arithmetic is deterministic and valuable (the draft requires three years after high-school graduation), but P(no extra-year grant) is not estimated and 'court dockets' are one-off events. Heavy hand-capture for few prospects.
raw_data: high school graduation and college enrolment dates
NCAA eligibility rulings and case dockets
nfl.prospect_eligibility_clock_and_nil_e.measurement_fix: Per prospect compute first eligible draft year = year in which three full seasons have elapsed since high-school graduation. Eligibility flag E = 1 if first eligible year <= target draft year. Extra-year risk X = P(player receives additional college eligibility via waiver or court ruling) = 1 if ruling announced, else base rate from 2021-2026 cases (decided cases won / filed, Beta(1,1) prior) when a case is pending, else 0. P(in pool) = E x (1 - X) x P(declare | NIL era, position, consensus round) from nfl.prospect_declaration_eligibility_medical's model. As-of: timestamp of latest ruling, statement or early-entry list.

nfl.prospect_pre_combine_athletic_prior.assessment: Clear regression with defined inputs, shrinkage and as-of day. Limits: only a minority of prospects have collegiate FAT track marks, GPS speeds are self-reported, and Combine 40 is itself noisy (hand vs laser, surface); train/test split should be by year. Paid Athletic Freaks list is optional.
raw_data: reported GPS top speed with source and date

nfl.prospect_slot_dispersion_model.assessment: The MARKET_MARKER flag is a false positive (it excludes boards citing sportsbook odds), but consensus boards can themselves absorb betting information so strictly market-free status is only approximate. 'Quantile or ordinal regression' is an unresolved choice, and historical board vintages (90/30/1 day) need own capture.
raw_data: consensus rank by date (90, 30, 1 days pre-draft)
nfl.prospect_slot_dispersion_model.measurement_fix: From 2010-2026 drafts (seven rounds) join consensus rank (mean of public big boards dated 90, 30 and 1 days before the draft; exclude mock drafts and any source that cites sportsbook odds) to realized pick. Fit ordinal logistic regression of draft-pick bucket (1-32 by pick, then round buckets) plus an undrafted category on log(rank), position (QB, EDGE, OT, other) and days-to-draft, with spread parameter rising with rank; shrink thin positions toward the pooled model with weight 20 draftees. Output a slot PMF over picks 1-257 + undrafted per prospect; cross-prospect order statistics by sampling slots sequentially without replacement. As-of the board vintage date.

nfl.qb_attempt_forecast.assessment: 'Expected spread bucket (model-based)' is ambiguous and invites inserting the betting spread (which would make it hybrid). Rest of the specification (NB, team effects, 2015+) is fine. Overlaps nfl.proe + nfl.pace but yields a distribution.

nfl.qb_attempt_forecast.measurement_fix: Negative-binomial regression on 2015+ QB-games (starting QBs) of pass attempts on log expected team plays (nfl.total_plays_state_model), neutral PROE (nfl.proe), own-model expected margin bucket (<=-7, -7..-3, -3..3, 3..7, >7 from nfl.own_team_rating_market_free; never a betting spread), wind>=15 mph flag, dome flag, opponent rush-EPA-allowed rank, with team random effect; output mean and NB dispersion. Mix over P(QB pulled early) from nfl.qb_blowout_pull_threshold (attempts after exit set to 0). As-of start of week; refit each season, walk-forward.

nfl.qb_blowout_pull_hazard.assessment: Same event as nfl.qb_blowout_pull_threshold (QB's last snap before game end by lead and clock) with coach random effect; the threshold input is better specified. The injury-exit piece belongs in nfl.in_game_exit_risk.

nfl.qb_blowout_pull_threshold.assessment: Conditioning the fit on games 'decided by 17+' selects on the final margin, which is unknown pregame and biases the pull rule (games where the starter stayed in were closer). Needs a hazard on in-game state across all games. Depth chart/backup identity is a legitimate pregame input.
raw_data: pbp: game_id, qb_id, play order, score_differential, game_seconds_remaining
depth chart / inactives for the backup identity
nfl.qb_blowout_pull_threshold.measurement_fix: For each head coach over the last 3 seasons (shrink coach effect toward league with k=6 games), fit a discrete-time logistic hazard over all starter-QB drives: P(starter's last snap is this drive | lead L in points, minutes remaining m, starter-injury flag excluded) using all games, not just those decided by 17+, with coach random effect. Pregame output: P(pulled before end) and expected minutes lost = sum over simulated margin paths (nfl.heteroskedastic_margin_sd around the own-model mean from nfl.model_team_points_mean, no betting spread) of the hazard. As-of the last pre-game depth chart.

nfl.qb_career_milestone_accrual.assessment: Same construct as nfl.career_record_chase_survival (rate x remaining games x availability x aging curve to a career/season total); this just specializes to passing TDs. Rate piece duplicates nfl.qb_expected_pass_td and nfl.season_to_date_pace.
raw_data: QB-season logs: games, attempts, TDs, age

nfl.qb_challenger_prior.assessment: Exact and computable: window, prior weight, regression on log draft pick and blending are stated. Minor gaps: the SD output is not defined, and the first-three-season training set is conditional on at least 150 dropbacks (survivorship toward successful picks).
raw_data: pbp: passer id, epa, qb_dropback, week

nfl.qb_change_hazard.assessment: Too vague: 'incumbent EPA+CPOE composite vs prior', 'owner pressure' and 'contract' are not measurable, hazard form lacks event definition (benching vs injury vs trade). About 10-20 true benchings per year give limited sample.
raw_data: QB-week table: starter id, performance, record, depth chart, bye
nfl.qb_change_hazard.measurement_fix: Event = a different QB is the week's starter for a non-injury reason (exclude injury inactives and rest weeks). Discrete-time logistic over team-weeks 2010-2025 with features: incumbent EPA/dropback over last 6 games minus nfl.qb_efficiency prior (z), incumbent turnovers per game last 4, team win% minus own-model expectation, weeks since bye, backup draft round (1, 2-3, 4+, UDFA), incumbent contracted-money flag (OTC), head-coach tenure in years; drop the unobservable 'owner pressure'. Ridge penalty by leave-one-season-out CV. Output weekly hazard h_w and cumulative 1 - prod(1-h_w) over scheduled non-bye weeks in the horizon. As-of report date.

nfl.qb_completion_count_model.assessment: Fully specified (windows, shrinkage k, clip, wind adjustment, beta-binomial rho) and market-free. Caveats: nflfastR cp/cpoe are produced by a model trained on all seasons including future ones, a mild backtest look-ahead; wind adjustment of -2 pp is a hard-coded assumption to refit.

nfl.qb_dropback_to_attempt_leakage.assessment: Title and text disagree: kneels are in the title but not in the formula, and kneels/spikes are not dropbacks in nflfastR (spikes are pass attempts). Pressure rate from 'charting vendors' is not defined and public pressure data is limited (participation was_pressure, 2018+).

nfl.qb_dropback_to_attempt_leakage.measurement_fix: Define leakage rate = (sacks + scrambles) / qb_dropback, excluding spikes and kneels from both numerator and denominator. Per QB over his last 17 starts before the as-of week, time-decayed with half-life 8 games, shrunk to the offence's rate with weight n/(n+150) dropbacks. Opponent adjustment: add b x logit-difference of the opposing defence's pressure rate (last 12 games, participation was_pressure; fall back to sack+QB-hit rate) versus league, with b fit by logistic regression 2018+ and the adjusted rate capped at league mean +/- 3 SD. Output expected fraction of dropbacks that do not become pass attempts.

nfl.qb_expected_pass_td.assessment: Specified logistic model with pbp-only baseline and participation-era upgrade, plus shrinkage. Mostly redundant with summing nfl.expected_touchdowns_by_play_location over receivers, but the QB aggregation and 70% regression of actual/expected are specific. Sacks/scrambles on dropbacks excluded from the denominator.

nfl.qb_scenario_rating_drop.assessment: The conversion constant is applied twice (EPA prior x dropbacks x 0.2 points per 0.01 EPA) and its value (0.2 points per 0.01 EPA per game) is asserted not shown: with ~38 dropbacks, 0.01 EPA/dropback is about 0.4 points. Needs a defined games-missed model and as-of depth chart.
raw_data: QB dropbacks and EPA by player
nfl.qb_scenario_rating_drop.measurement_fix: Per team: rating drop (points per game) = (EPAdb_QB1 - EPAdb_QB2) x 38 expected dropbacks, where EPAdb = career-regressed EPA/dropback from nfl.qb_efficiency shrunk toward league mean with weight n/(n+300) dropbacks and the 38/game and slope (1 EPA per dropback = 1 point of margin per dropback, not a separate regression constant) are refit by regressing team game margin on QB EPA prior 2010-2025. Missed-games distribution: negative binomial of QB games missed per season by age bucket and prior-season games missed (2010-2025, ridge). Scenario tree: QB1 plays all remaining games, part, none; output expected wins lost (drop x 0.03 wins per point) and distribution. As-of latest depth chart and injury report.

nfl.qb_scramble_yield_given_pressure.assessment: Covers the same quantities as nfl.qb_rushing (designed runs, scrambles, conditioned on pressure and opponent contain, shrunk to career prior). Pressure and 'spy' tendencies need charting data not in nflverse pbp.

nfl.qb_target_concentration.assessment: Herfindahl of a QB's target distribution is largely a function of his receivers' quality and is already captured by nfl.targets and nfl.target_competition; the multiplier b is fit post hoc and is likely unstable. Low incremental value.

nfl.quarter_total_order_statistics.assessment: Detailed simulation spec with clear inputs, regulation-only convention, dead-heat payout rule and calibration. nfl.rating_state_space.measurement_fix: Kalman filter on a 64-dim state (off and def EPA/play rating per team). Season boundary: state = rho x last-season final state + (1-rho) x league mean, rho estimated by regressing year t+1 final ratings on year t (2005+), expected about 0.5-0.6; preseason prior variance = residual variance of that regression. Weekly process variance sigma_p^2 estimated by marginal likelihood on 2005-2025. Observation = team-game opponent-adjusted EPA/play (offence and defence separately) with observation weight w = 1 for plays with 0.05<=wp<=0.95 (no-spread wp) and 0.2 otherwise. Output posterior mean and variance per team as-of previous week; refit walk-forward.

nfl.sb_defender_highlight_hazard.measurement_fix: Per defender: sack rate per team pass-rush snap and per opponent dropback over the last 3 seasons (regular season + playoffs), shrunk to position mean with weight 12 games; expected sacks in the game = player rate x opponent expected dropbacks (nfl.pace x nfl.proe) x opponent sack-rate-allowed ratio vs league. Takeaway rate analogously from interceptions + forced fumbles recovered. Defensive TD hazard per team = takeaways x 0.06 league conversion rate (refit 2000-2025). P(2+ sacks) = 1 - P(0) - P(1) under Poisson; P(any defensive TD for player) from the share of team takeaways; combine with outcome sim from the matchup model. As-of week-of-game injury report.

nfl.total_distribution_tail.measurement_fix: Fit a shifted-lognormal (or NB-mixture) to 2000-2025 regular-season game totals conditioned on walk-forward expected total E_g in terciles (<40, 40-48, >48) and weather regime (calm/dome, wind>=15 or temp<32); for seasons before 2015 compute E_g with the ridge rating of nfl.own_team_rating_market_free (never a betting total), for 2015+ use nfl.model_team_points_mean. Report P(total >= 70) and P(total <= 24) with 5,000-game bootstrap CI; validate calibration by decile of E_g. As-of season start, refreshed weekly.

nfl.total_plays_state_model.assessment: Leak risk: covariates like pass-completion rate and penalty rate must be pregame rolling values, not game-level realized values, and 'as-of previous week' must be explicit. Overlaps nfl.pace's expected plays.
raw_data: pbp: game_id, plays by team, seconds per play, qtr, score_differential, penalty
nfl.total_plays_state_model.measurement_fix: Regress total plays per game (2015+) on both teams' rolling neutral seconds per play (last 10 games, half-life 5), PROE, own and opponent run rate, expected absolute margin (own model from nfl.own_team_rating_market_free, not market), rolling completion rate and penalty rate (all computed from games before the as-of week), with team and opponent random effects and ridge shrinkage; output expected plays and SD. Weather only via wind/dome flags from the kickoff forecast. As-of previous week; fit walk-forward.

nfl.trick_play_and_goal_line_pass_events.assessment: Clear rate definitions (non-QB passes; passes from the 1-yard line, sacks/scrambles excluded) with shrinkage and Poisson aggregation. Rare events so coach random effect is weak. Market-free.
raw_data: pbp: game_id, posteam, passer_player_id, pass_attempt, sack, qb_scramble, yardline_100, down

nfl.vote_outcome_model.assessment: Umbrella over many awards with undefined 'narrative flags' and an aggregation layer; the T100 ordered logit is a different model. Vote histories are small (about 25 seasons per award), so overfitting is the main risk.
raw_data: historical winners and vote tallies, candidate stats, previous T100 ranks
nfl.vote_outcome_model.measurement_fix: Per award, conditional (multinomial) logit of winner on candidate features: team win% at announcement, statistical rank within position (EPA or season totals), prior award wins, position dummy, drop undefined narrative flags, with ridge penalty by leave-one-season-out CV and prior weight 3 pseudo-observations. T100: ordered logit on previous rank, change in production, position group, age. Output P(candidate=winner) and P(rank=r); group markets P(group) = sum of P(win) by team at announcement time with 1/N co-winner payout; Executive of the Year tie probability = own-award co-winner frequency shrunk to pooled co-winner frequency of comparable awards with weight 10 awards. As-of announcement date.

nfl.voter_exposure_and_straw_poll_signal.assessment: Manual media straw polls and primetime counts have a short history (under 10 years), subjective capture and unknown correlation with the actual voter panel; weights fit to few award-years will overfit. Market-free as stated (no Kalshi use).

nfl.weather_total_response.measurement_fix: Outcome = realized game total points minus own-model expected total from nfl.model_team_points_mean (never a betting total). Hierarchical regression on 2010+ games: wind piecewise-linear with knots 10, 15, 20 mph, temperature knots 32, 50 F, precipitation flag, dome flag, and bin random effects shrunk with k=100 games. Fit on observed game-time weather; at prediction time use forecast vintages at 24 h and 3 h pregame and propagate forecast error (estimated from archive vs observed) by errors-in-variables attenuation. As-of pregame forecast.
